author: LadyLeigh
name: Polls
short: Build timed polls with live button voting and team restrictions.
description: Interactive poll previews, role restrictions, configurable vote limits, persistent voting, automatic results delivery, force closing and deletion.
end_user_data_statement: Stores member IDs and selected options until results delivery, poll deletion or user data deletion. Retains completed poll and results message locations until poll deletion. Published results remain in Discord unless deleted with polldelete.
